answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 56946 Country: India Title: About Azaan Question: I want to know if somebody recites azaan wrongly (wordings and pronunciations) what is the fatwa about it? Please answer this as soon as possible. Answer ID: 56946 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 150/147/B=03/1436) Send that muezzin to some Qari for a few days so that he could correct his pronunciation of azaan and then assign him the duty of muezzin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
